title: Stonesaga Campaign Journal
summary: A shared campaign journal for the Stonesaga board game — crafting discoveries, behemoths, challenges, culture, and cave-wall art.
description: A table-friendly companion for the Stonesaga board game. The crafting side records discovered recipes and dead-end codes and explores material combinations from token pip data, automatically inferring interchangeable pairs that share the same edge pips. The journal side tracks tribe culture, behemoths, the challenge record by epoch, looming challenges, investigations, and free notes, plus a cave-wall gallery drawn in the app with the six game-box pencil colours. The whole group shares one journal via Google Drive sync — newest-wins merging, per-conflict review, and undo for deletions — or simple JSON export and import. Works on phones and tablets with no server or build step.
